entry.summary:
Ever wondered w
hat it’s actually like to practise medicine in New Zealand? 🇳🇿🩺  

Join GynoMum Michelle for a typical workday as a gynecologist in beautiful New Zealand. After moving here from New York City, her daily routine changed completely—from starting my mornings with a peaceful beach walk to experiencing half the work stress she used to have.

Learn more about what being an Obstetrician and Gynaecologist with Health New Zealand is like on our website ➡️ healthnz.govt.nz/OG
